verdict.rationale: The release notes document a model selector that works across all agent backends and lets users pick specific models (GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5.5). Docs also cover a sub-agent model reference and choosing Codex or Bedrock-hosted Claude for sessions, so choosing a specific model is clearly supported. Missing for 10: any evidence of an automatic model-selection mode to switch away from, in-depth docs on per-session or per-task model overrides, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
